verdict.rationale: iTerm2 supports AppleScript scripting to launch the application and open multiple sessions with profiles into new tabs/windows, plus a Python API for automation and profiles that trigger based on context (hostname, directory), which together enable scripted project workspace startup. Community evidence corroborates the Python API as a practical automation tool ('basically AppleScript for iTerm except... it lets you touch pretty much everything'). Missing for 10: a single documented one-command 'open layout X' example or independent hands-on confirmation of full workspace/layout restoration via script.
